scope: Extend the completed ARC-Challenge half-depth experiment to the four existing tasks.
primary_mean: Equal arithmetic weight for each of the four task accuracies, using each frozen primary metric.

bootstrap.method: Paired question resampling independently within each fixed task; equal-weight mean of task differences; percentile 95% interval

permutation.method: Two-sided paired sign flips on correctness discordances within tasks; equal-weight mean; plus-one Monte Carlo p

multiplicity.suite: Holm over three mean contrasts using frozen task primary metrics; secondary metric views report descriptive means and differences.
multiplicity.tasks: Holm over 12 task contrasts (four tasks times three comparisons), using frozen task primary metrics

timing: Three fixed length-quantile batches of eight candidates per task, warmup 2 and repetitions 6; independent policies on same H200 allocation; macro speedup geometric mean, per-task values reported.
